Single monocular microscope retains eyepiece, body tube, nosepiece, one active downward objective, separate stage, connected arm and base, coaxial coarse and fine focus outlines, and one substage mirror with attached stem. Thin parts and controls are independently enlarged, with a 9 mm turret/stage depth and 9 mm fine-control diameter. The objective ends above the stage. No extra objective, lamp or specimen is added; source stage aperture and three-dimensional optical clearance remain unresolved.
